notes.title: Big Bugfix Update is Here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!



Huge thanks to all of you who supported Lord Ambermaze at launch, shared your comments and reviews, and reported bugs. Thanks to you, we’ve got more work to do — and we’ve prepared our very first big bugfix update.



Update the game, play, and don’t forget to leave a review if you haven’t yet!



Here’s what we fixed:

Bug where the Mushroom Minion during the Lava Kraken boss fight stopped reacting to sword hits and didn’t spawn lava tiles.

Bug where buying Fried Chicken at Blu’s shop didn’t restore HP.

Bug where the game froze when a mob appeared during the Robo-Beetle boss fight.

Bug where the bottom border of some rooms was cut off on the minimap.

Bug where controls froze during the Lord boss fight when stone walls reappeared.

Bug where using the “Piercing Shot” perk on spiked balls caused the game to freeze.

Bug where certain modifier statues became inactive too early.

Bug where Robo-Beetle’s minions didn’t disappear after his death.

Bug where a Robo-Beetle minion could become invulnerable if a stalactite fell on it.
Bug where the Rufa statue granting +2 to shots didn’t work.
Bug that prevented players from receiving the final achievements!

Fixed blocker when buying mana from Blu.

Fixed multiple texture bugs.


Text and localization fixes:

Fixed incorrect intro credits starting in the wrong languages.

Fixed incorrect description of the Vampirism Potion in English.

Fixed incorrect description of Zeus’s Ring in French.

Fixed incorrect description of the Wind Gust Potion in German.

Fixed broken dialogues with Diggeria.

Fixed numerous typos in cutscenes and dialogues.

Fixed numerous typos in Rufa’s statue and artifact descriptions.


Gameplay improvements:

Reworked the final boss and his wave patterns.

Adjusted the logic in trials where you must attack only with a sword — using the shield is no longer counted as a failure, since it’s defensive, not offensive.


And one more thing: Rufa has lost her levitation powers and no longer floats in the middle of a chasm in some of the colored puzzle rooms.



With love,
 The Lord Ambermaze Team

notes.title: Only 6 days left until the release of Lord Ambermaze!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!



The day you step into the mystical maze to battle toothy fruits and giant creepy-crawlies is almost here. But before that happens, a quick reminder: the game’s demo will be closed soon — so make sure to give it a try while you still can!



The full release is coming on September 17 at 07:00 AM PT, 04:00 PM CET.


We’ve wrapped up all the balancing tweaks and bug fixes, and right now we’re polishing and testing the final build.



The bosses? Oh, they’re tougher, cooler, and way more exciting than before. Trust us — this won’t be your average backyard weed-pulling session!


Here’s what’s waiting for you at launch:

8 challenging maze-like levels, each trickier than the last

Over 10 unique characters to befriend and chat with

6 epic boss battles

Loads of trial rooms that will put your skills to the ultimate test


And for those who want the full immersion, you’ll also be able to grab our beautifully crafted artbook and atmospheric OST to dive deeper into the mysterious island and its dark ruler’s story.



So don’t forget to add Lord Ambermaze to your Wishlist, play the demo while it’s still live, and get ready to share your feedback with us.




With love,

The Lord Ambermaze Team

notes.title: Release date changed again — to September 17
Spikes sharpened, plums furious, demo ready, release date… moved to September 2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!



We have some news: some good and one not so good.



There has been a small change regarding the release of the game

Originally, we planned to launch on August 14, but as often happens in development, we slightly overestimated our capacity. We need a bit more time to finish testing, fix all the bugs, and apply the final polish. So we’ve decided to push the release back by two weeks.


The new release date is September 2.

It wasn't very good news, but there's only good news to come! 

We promised that you'd be able to start playing on August 14th, and you will be able to, no matter what, because we'll be releasing a new demo version of the game!

[img src="https://i.ibb.co/N25LBDrB/Lord-lava.gif"]

You’ll play through the first levels and discover the beginning of the story. And your progress won’t be lost — all saves will carry over into the full game.


Meanwhile, we want to tell you about two major additions we’ve recently made:



Welcome to the Dark Lord’s Castle

The final level has arrived! This is where Zin will finish their long and perilous journey. Expect tough new puzzles, deadly traps, and — attention! — your last chance to romance characters, rescue them from the island, and unlock the most heartfelt (or unexpected!) ending.


[img src="https://i.ibb.co/HLQCSfP9/lord-boss-1mp4.gif"]

And as the evil plum on top — the ultimate showdown with Lord Ambermaze, who is actually... Nope, we won’t say it. That would be a massive spoiler. A MEGA SPOILER. So play and discover it all yourself.



Dungeon Map — Never Get Lost Again!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41479895/8fc94482b477ae9c449aea172ce746dbc4dc3ff9.png"]

A maze is made for getting lost, wandering, and making surprising discoveries — but we believe a map won’t ruin the fun. In fact, it’s here to help! Now you can track where you’ve been, how areas connect, and what you might’ve missed. Perfect for figuring out what that mysterious lever actually did.

The release is just around the corner — so don’t forget to wishlist Lord Ambermaze, join our Discord, and get ready for the ultimate summer adventure!


Thank you for your support! ❤️




With love,

The Lord Ambermaze Team
